cues.text: Paulownia Mall, Fountain Square. Nozomi sits on a bench and gets up, smiling, when he sees you.
Two men walk up, a young man in a knit cap and a man in sunglasses, and Nozomi steps toward them. You turn to face them: one is a young man you have seen before.
Nozomi walks off past you, leaving you behind. The two men follow after him.
